verdict.rationale: The RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell is a workstation GPU, a physical hardware component. Issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials to an agent is an account and service-level capability, not something a graphics card could ship. Nothing in the evidence shows the product offers any credential-issuing capability that would make this axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
